entities.name: Ainmuire mac Sétnai
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ainmuire mac Sétnai or Ainmire or Ainmere was a High King of Ireland from the Cenél Conaill branch of the Uí Néill. He was the great-grandson of Conall Gulban, founder of this branch. He ruled from 566 to 569. He was the first high king from the Cenél Conaill.
